description: Full-page capture by scrolling: stitched segments of ~2 viewports (≤1568px), or one image per viewport with stitch=false. Expensive: ~2.7k image tokens per segment, only max_segments returned, the rest via segment_offset. Reading the text you need is cheaper by an order of magnitude — prefer read_page, extract or find_text unless layout is the question.

max_scrolls.description: Cap on scroll steps: a taller page is captured only up to here

max_segments.description: Images returned from the top (≈2.7k image tokens each); segment_offset for the rest

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one
